name: townhouse-desert
description: Burgher's Townhouse, the desert look (ROADMAP 49.10b): the shipped Townhouse drawn again as a caravan merchant's house: a street arcade, a lattice rawshan, a qa'a lantern on a flat roof, a loggia and terrace, a windcatcher tower and a walled court.
